import csv, sys

"""Supplier order prototype: builds a weekly order from par levels and current stock."""
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Item:
    name: str
    unit: str
    par: float      # target on-hand quantity
    on_hand: float  # counted quantity
    case_size: float = 1.0  # supplier sells in multiples of this


def build_order(items: list[Item]) -> list[tuple[str, float, str]]:
    """Return (name, quantity_to_order, unit) for items below par, rounded up to case size."""
    order = []
    for it in items:
        short = it.par - it.on_hand
        if short <= 0:
            continue
        cases = -(-short // it.case_size)  # ceiling division
        order.append((it.name, cases * it.case_size, it.unit))
    return order


if __name__ == "__main__":
    stock = [
        Item("Roma tomatoes", "lb", par=30, on_hand=12, case_size=25),
        Item("Yellow onions", "lb", par=40, on_hand=22, case_size=50),
        Item("Chicken thigh", "lb", par=60, on_hand=60, case_size=10),
    ]
    for name, qty, unit in build_order(stock):
        print(f"{name}: {qty:g} {unit}")

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class Item:
    name: str
    unit: str
    par: float      # target on-hand quantity
